info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Discount Pricing API
info.description: The Discount Pricing API provides businesses with the ability to retrieve pricing details associated with discount offerings on specific products. This endpoint allows users to access information regarding promotional pricing strategies and adjustments applied to products in their portfolio. Typical consumers include product managers and finance teams who need to analyze pricing trends and implement discount strategies effectively. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their product management processes and optimize their pricing models.

get.summary: Retrieve discount pricing for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the discount pricing details for the specified resource identified by RES-100045. Utilize this information to analyze pricing strategies and apply relevant discounts effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve discount pricing information for a specific product. It should include all relevant parameters necessary for the API to process the request and return the appropriate pricing details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the discount pricing information.
